sanskrit_verse: मुख्यैः सह समूहानां विसंवादो यदा भवेत् । तदा विचारयेत् राजा स्वमार्गे स्थापयेच् च तान् ॥
transliteration: mukhyaiḥ saha samūhānāṃ visaṃvādo yadā bhavet | tadā vicārayet rājā svamārge sthāpayec ca tān ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When discord arises between leaders and groups, the King must investigate and establish them in their rightful path.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign's duty to restore alignment
Causation is traced to dissonance between leadership and collective integrity
Capacity-based responsibility demands active inquiry by the ruler
Restoration logic prioritizes re-establishing dharma over assigning blame
Consciousness alignment occurs when all parties are guided back to their svadharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF (dispute EXISTS BETWEEN leader AND group) THEN (sovereign MUST initiate investigation)
IF (discord IDENTIFIED) THEN (sovereign MUST determine causal misalignment)
IF (misalignment DETECTED) THEN (sovereign MUST guide parties TO svamarga)
IF (parties RESTORED TO svadharma) THEN (case RESOLVED without punitive action)
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when disputes arise between executive authorities and societal collectives, the court must act as the sovereign-investigator, tracing root causes of disharmony and issuing directives that realign all stakeholders with constitutional svamarga, bypassing punitive frameworks in favor of dharmic restoration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that conflict originates in misperception of svadharma; anupūrvaśaḥ shows that correction flows from sovereign clarity; proportional responsibility lies in restoring vision, not inflicting consequence; non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering is not justice but failure of alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign inquiry to trace causal distortion
Engage conflicting parties in svadharma reorientation process
Deploy consciousness-alignment facilitators to dissolve egoic positions
Reintegrate parties through completion of shared dharmic purpose
Establish ongoing svamarga monitoring to prevent recurrence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Conflict is resolved through sovereign clarity. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
